blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Protesters burned an effigy of US President Donald Trump on Saturday ahead of his expected arrival in the country for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit to show their opposition for the US-led Pax Silica initiative.
